name: Dyscalculia Network
description: UK network providing dyscalculia and maths-difficulty information, awareness work, training and a specialist assessor/tutor directory.
intended_use: Find UK-focused dyscalculia information, community material and routes to specialist assessors or tutors.
audience_or_context: Children, adults, families, educators and employers looking for UK dyscalculia information or specialist-directory routes.
limitations: The network is not a statutory diagnostic service and directory inclusion does not make ND Oracle responsible for an individual assessor or tutor.
Dyscalculia definitions and assessment practice are not fully uniform; a directory listing is not evidence that assessment or tuition will benefit a particular person.
cost_or_access_notes: Much information is publicly accessible; training, events, assessment or tuition may involve charges set by the provider or listed specialists.
conflicts_of_interest: The organisation offers paid training and a paid professional directory; ND Oracle records this commercial context and does not endorse listed practitioners.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
